visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, pink highlights, and a pink lace headband sits on a yellow sofa. She wears a white lace cardigan over a white dress and holds a red promotional flyer for the "Nintendo Switch 2 Experience TAIPEI" event. The background is a white brick wall. (2) The video transitions to a screen capture of a desktop browser. The mouse cursor navigates the Nintendo Switch experience event's official registration website, highlighting headers and buttons. (3) The interface shows group registration options for "Normal" or "Family" groups with stylized character icons. Large yellow variety captions appear at the bottom center. (4) The screen recording demonstrates filling out the form: selecting dates (July 5 or 6, 2025), inputting name and email, and checking agreement boxes. (5) A confirmation screen appears showing a success message, a registration link, and a specific code "7272-". The cursor demonstrates copying and sharing the link. (6) The camera returns to the woman on the yellow sofa. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures, concluding the video with a wave.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 任天堂 Switch 2 台北體驗會. [Slogan]: 抽選報名開始囉! (2) [Subtitle]: 手把手教你怎麼報名. (3) [Subtitle]: 也把這支影片 傳給你的朋友. (4) [Logo]: aottergirls. [Subtitle]: 這裡. (5) [Subtitle]: 首先 先進到體驗會的 官方報名頁面. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後看你要選擇 一般組 還是家庭組. (7) [Subtitle]: 我們這邊先教 一般組的報名方法. (8) [Subtitle]: 點進去再按下面的報名. (9) [Subtitle]: 接下來選擇你要報名的日期. (10) [Subtitle]: 如果你兩天都想報名 那就要送兩次的報名表. (11) [Subtitle]: 接著 下面填你的名字. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後下面再選 你是要跟朋友一起入場呢 還是你要自己一個人獨享. (13) [Subtitle]: 下面的報名條款 閱讀完後就勾同意. (14) [Subtitle]: 然後按下一步. (15) [Subtitle]: 下一頁的報名資訊 確認沒錯後就按發送. (16) [Subtitle]: 這樣你自己這邊就報名完成了. (17) [Subtitle]: 它下面會有一個報名連結和代碼. (18) [Subtitle]: 把這個報名連結 傳給你同行的朋友. (19) [Subtitle]: 他點進連結 就可以開始直接報名了. (20) [Subtitle]: 連結點進去並登入之後. (21) [Subtitle]: 你是一般組的同行者. (22) [Subtitle]: 確認代碼沒錯後 就按下一步. (23) [Subtitle]: 然後一樣填朋友、自己的名字 並同意條款. (24) [Subtitle]: 最後再確認一次個人資料 就可以按下發送. (25) [Subtitle]: 這樣第二個人也就報名完成囉. (26) [Subtitle]: 報名截止是 6月9號. (27) [Subtitle]: 而抽選結果 會在 6月19號公佈. (28) [Subtitle]: 體驗會則是在 7/5、7/6 在花博爭艷館. (29) [Subtitle]: 祝大家 都能抽中喔!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, high-pitched female voice begins an energetic narration over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a consistent 120 BPM tempo. The audio is extremely clean with a studio-quality finish. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a visual shift. The narration continues at a fast, articulate pace, guiding the listener through steps. The BGM remains as a steady, mid-volume bed underneath the speech. (3) Occasional 'click' or 'ding' sound effects punctuate the narration, coinciding with mouse clicks shown on screen. The narrator's pitch variability is high, conveying enthusiasm. (4) The audio maintains a high information density as the speaker lists specific dates and registration requirements. (5) The narration concludes with a warm, rising intonation for a positive sign-off, with the BGM cutting off cleanly at the video's end.
